LESSON: USALAMA

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.15: Usalama

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Usalama. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua msamiati ambao hutumiwa katika usalama ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na usalama ili kujenga usomaji bora
3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa usalama ili kuimarisha ufahamu
4. kutumia msamiati wa usalama katika sentensi ili kuimarisha ufahamu e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na usalama ili kujenga uandishi bora f) kuthamini usalama katika mazingira yake. 96 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Maagano

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua msamiati ambao hutumiwa katika usalama ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutambua msamiati ambao hutumiwa katika usalama ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na usalama ili kujenga usomaji bora
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na usalama ili kujenga usomaji bora. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa usalama ili kuimarisha ufahamu
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kueleza maana ya msamiati wa usalama ili kuimarisha ufahamu. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kutumia msamiati wa usalama katika sentensi ili kuimarisha ufahamu e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na usalama ili kujenga uandishi bora f) kuthamini usalama katika mazingira yake. 96 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Maagano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia msamiati wa usalama katika sentensi ili kuimarisha ufahamu e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na usalama ili kujenga uandishi bora f) kuthamini usalama katika mazingira yake. 96 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Maagano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Usalama.
2. Explain Usalama to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Usalama.
4. Show that you can: kutambua msamiati ambao hutumiwa katika usalama ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Usalama. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Usalama important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua msamiati ambao hutumiwa katika usalama ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na usalama ili kujenga usomaji bora
3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa usalama ili kuimarisha ufahamu
4. kutumia msamiati wa usalama katika sentensi ili kuimarisha ufahamu e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na usalama ili kujenga uandishi bora f) kuthamini usalama katika mazingira yake. 96 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Maagano

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
